capabilities: force read mode when opening files in configured folders
match folders and files with glob patterns
enable or disable the behavior via commands
motivation: The README says it is useful to prevent accidental edits or enforce a read-only experience for certain files.
problem: Obsidian opens notes in editable mode by default, so read-only reference files can be accidentally modified.
summary: Plugin that forces Markdown files in configured folders to always open in read (preview) mode to prevent edits.
